Architected secure, scalable, and high-performance applications for banking and financial services,
ensuring compliance with industry standards and seamless integration with enterprise platforms.

jobs.role: Serving as a strategic Application Architect for State Bank of India, providing end-to-end technical
jobs.location: State Bank of India, Mumbai, India
bullets: Serving as a strategic Application Architect for State Bank of India, providing end-to-end technical leadership and architectural direction for modernizing core and peripheral banking applications.
Spearheaded the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient application architectures, with a focus on AI-driven modernization, system interoperability, and cloud-readiness.
Responsible for architectural reviews, design validation, and defining modernization roadmaps aligned with the bank's digital transformation goals.
Created detailed architectural documentation, proof of concepts (PoCs), and technical feasibility assessments to evaluate emerging technologies.
Developed SOPs, reusable frameworks, and best practice guidelines to ensure consistency, regulatory compliance, and maintainability across projects.
Worked cross-functionally with development, security, DevOps, and business teams to drive innovation while ensuring adherence to performance, security, and governance standards.
Designed and architected Price Manager, a modular application for managing and regulating asset pricing across Vodafone’s global operations.
Built on AWS using services like EC2, S3, Lambda, and RDS, ensuring scalability and integration with both internal and external systems.
Enabled real-time monitoring and performance optimization through Dynatrace.
Focused on modularity, interoperability, and maintainability to support dynamic pricing and global asset governance.

jobs.location: Royal Bank of Canada, Mumbai, India
bullets: Contributed to the customization and modular development of the Collibra Data Governance Platform, enabling a centralized view of business-critical data assets, including domains, metrics, APIs, models, and data products.
Developed the Payment Module using Angular 8, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript for front-end enhancements.
On the backend, implemented functionality using Spring MVC, Spring Batch, and a standalone Spring Boot reporting tool.
Supported the creation of custom asset types, rules, domains, and user profiles based on business requirements.
Led efforts in cloud migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and deployed services using Kubernetes, ensuring scalability and alignment with client infrastructure strategies.
Worked on GPAC, a cloud-based policy administration system for managing Whole and Term Life insurance policies, enabling agents to view and process detailed policy information.
Migrated the application from Java 7 to Java 8, used Hibernate with DB2/Oracle, and deployed via Jenkins in AWS with monitoring through Splunk.
Also developed BigFish, an automated trade reporting system for DTCC GTR, handling global trade data using Angular 4, Spring Boot, Struts, and Hibernate.
Focused on multithreading, RESTful APIs, and automated reporting.
Ensured high performance, regulatory compliance, and seamless vendor integration.

jobs.role: As Full stack java developer, I worked on application known as RDMS (Resilience Data Management
bullets: As Full stack java developer, I worked on application known as RDMS (Resilience Data Management System).
This application deals with the data and role management for JPMC employees for critical applications data.
Technical stack for the application includes Primefaces, struts 3.x, Java 7, spring MVC, spring batch, cognos, Jenkins, Mokito.
FrontEnd – Angular 17, primefaces, Nodejs, javascript
BackEnd – Java 8/11/17, spring framework, & spring MVC, Spring boot, spring batch, Multi threading, Restful webservices
Database/ORM – Oracle, DB2, Sql Server, Shell scripting, Websphere, Tomcat server 9 , python
